signal_decision_timestamp: ts_init of completed bar triggering H050 or regime flip
order_submission_timestamp: ts_init of completed signal bar (immediate synchronous dispatch)
order_fill_timestamp: ts_init of next sequential completed 1s bar (t_submit + 1s)
order_fill_price_model: Next-bar open price + 1 tick adverse slippage

policies_compared.C0: Confirmed flip exit control (H050_0 entry -> R2 flip exit)
policies_compared.C1: Opposing H050 exit (H050_0 entry -> first valid opposing H050_1 -> R2 fallback)
